title: Test tokens.json
description: Schema for test case token lists (tokens.json) in the SysProLang compiler test suite.

items.title: Token
items.description: A single token produced by the lexer.

kind.description: Token kind identifier (e.g., IDENT, INT, PLUS, SEMI, EOF, …).

line.description: Line number (1-based) where the token starts in the source file.

column.description: Column number (1-based) where the token starts in the source line.
